recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Treat future changes to registry rendering or interface inheritance as FHIR-38999 follow-up work or a new tracker, not as a reason to restore the old FHIR-12987 conformance-* block.

additional_context: FHIR-38999 later made a Published/Persuasive with Modification decision about interface SearchParameter representation and commit 6c4526c5e03f2ec90cc8d0a5f62d89e3812e76dc removed the obsolete conformance-* common block. Current build-scope source declares CanonicalResource and MetadataResource as active interface resources and defines shared interface SearchParameters for the same common metadata family. Current CI output publishes those shared interface ids and no old conformance-status or resource-specific status duplicates. Community searches found no conflicting FHIR-12987 discussion.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit because restoring the old conformance-* block would contradict later applied source history, while the current active interface source already provides the common conformance metadata search capability.
